recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-32508 unless a future work-group decision changes the intended semantics of Procedure.location.
issue_request: FHIR-32508 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by Patient Care. It requested removing the Procedure.location requirements wording "Ties a procedure to where the records are likely kept" because Procedure.location identifies where the procedure actually happened, not where records are stored.
initial_application: Git commit 85f9053b69a48a8556aad22b881efe9997508eef, titled "J#32508 - Procedure.location clarification", removed the obsolete requirements value from source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml. The same commit also addressed FHIR-32506 on Procedure.performer, but the Procedure.location hunk directly applied FHIR-32508.
additional_context: Procedure is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Current combined-branch source has Procedure.location short text "Where the procedure happened" and a definition about where the procedure actually happened, with no remaining requirements value. The Patient Care Confluence minutes page references FHIR-32508, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative Procedure source already reflects the approved clarification, and the obsolete record-storage rationale is absent from source/procedure and source/fhir.ini on the combined branch.

related_jiras.note: Implemented in the same historical commit, but it concerns Procedure.performer and was not decided in this seed reconciliation.
